verdict.rationale: Rive has no dedicated 'automations' object. Its own Revision History auto-saves every change to a file, lets you select and preview any past revision, and restores revisions non-destructively. That versions, reviews, and rolls back the scripts, state machines, and agent-generated content stored in a file, but only at whole-file level. Missing for 10: versioning scoped to individual automations or scripts, diff-style review of changes, independent or hands-on corroboration of rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Rive tracks all changes and stores them in the Revision History.
This guarantees that even restoring revisions is non-destructive, and you can always go back to the previous version of the file.
Select a revision to preview it and press the Edit Current Revision button.
